history.summary: A 1,313 sqft 99-year 4BR at The Terrace (an EC, 2018) in D19 Punggol at $2.3M ($1,752 PSF), just 200m from Kadaloor LRT. Waterway-EC with strong on-paper PSF, but $1,752 PSF and a $2.3M quantum are high for a privatised EC in OCR Punggol.
history.rating_rationale: The Terrace is a former Executive Condo on Punggol Waterway with excellent immediate access (200m to Kadaloor LRT) and Punggol Digital District as a regional catalyst. But $1,752 PSF is a full price for a 99-year ex-EC, and the $2.3M quantum sits above the deepest-demand band while the buyer pool for a $2.3M Punggol unit is HDB-upgrader-capped. No URA data; arena slightly above .500. Good location and PDD upside balance the rich EC pricing — a clean Neutral.
